name: 20710 · Bladensburg, MD
findings: ZIP 20710 (Bladensburg) has 37 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (58% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 20710 (Bladensburg) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 12 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 27% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 20710 (Bladensburg) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 73% of the typical level).
